rocket_materials.description: Melting points in Kelvin for rocket-relevant metals

electronegativity.description: Pauling-scale electronegativity for 10 common elements (H, C, N, O, F, Na, Cl, S, Fe, Au)

plasma_basics.description: Fundamental plasma constants: electron/proton mass, elementary charge, vacuum permittivity, Boltzmann constant, and first ionization energies of H/He/Ar. All constants corroborated by two independent sources (NIST CODATA + Physics Hypertextbook). Ionization energies cross-checked against NIST CCCBDB/Atomic Data for He and periodic-table.org + Wikipedia data page for H/Ar.

critical_points.description: Critical temperature (K) and critical pressure (MPa) for seven common fluids. Every entry corroborated by two independent sources (Engineering ToolBox + Wikipedia/peer-reviewed). Values are the standard literature critical constants; small last-digit differences between sources are expected.
